project.name: appjorge
project.productType: Local-first boutique point of sale and stock

must: Use the selected Studio-inspired theme and native components
Show base and charged unit prices separately
Review cart total before recording a sale
Record purchase cost on stock intake; preserve unknown historical costs as unknown
Distinguish expected stock margin from realized gross profit or loss based on charged prices
avoid: DOM-only or Tailwind components in React Native
External component dependencies for this change

decisions.decision: Extend the existing warm native sales UI with per-line base/agreed prices, a review cart, purchase cost and honest gross profit or loss. Reuse project primitives.

User selected Studio: Susu's Boutique branding, restrained green and neutral palette, boutique editorial headings, Shopify-inspired management layout; existing Tienda, Vender and Logística navigation at bottom on mobile and top on desktop.

Store dashboard uses four factual KPIs, investment and stock progress, collapsible forecasts, and a temporary expense input. Mobile is one column; desktop uses a wide management layout. Unknown costs remain pending and no trends are invented.

evidence.fact: Native theme and reusable controls inspected
